texts.preamble: Hemant Jadhav vs Department Of Food And Drugs ...
texts.arguments: Appearing counsel for the petitioner contends that during HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH BENCH AT INDORE trial before the trial court, the petitioner was released on regular bail and his custodial sentence was previously suspended by the lower appellate Court and there is no possibility of early hearing of this criminal revision before this Court, hence, it is prayed that custodial sentence of petitioner be suspended during the pendency of this criminal revision, which is strongly opposed by the learned Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of the respondent No.2/State.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Appearing counsel for the petitioner contends that during HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH BENCH AT INDORE trial before the trial court, the petitioner was released on regular bail and his custodial sentence was previously suspended by the lower appellate Court and there is no possibility of early hearing of this criminal revision before this Court, hence, it is prayed that custodial sentence of petitioner be suspended during the pendency of this criminal revision, which is strongly opposed by the learned Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of the respondent No.2/State.
